title: RNAi vector feeding protocol for distal tip cell \(DTC) migration studies in _C. elegans_
protocol: Streak out culture from desired library well on LB/Amp plate (optional).
Culture bacteria containing each RNAi clone in 1 ml LB medium with 40 μg/ml ampicillin overnight.
Chunk a starved nematode plate and allow nematodes to recover on fresh E. coli OP50-seeded NGM plates for two days.
In a 24-well format, spot 20 μl of each culture in a single well containing NGM agar with 6 mM IPTG and 25 μg/ml carbenicillin.
In the 6 cm format, spread out 150 μl of culture on plates.
Release eggs from gravid hermaphrodites using alkaline hypochlorite solution.
Transfer eggs to plates seeded with E. coli HT115(DE3) bacteria expressing dsRNA.
Score animals for clear patches using dissecting microscopy.
Mount the animals on agar pads using 0.08M sodium azide as an anesthetic.
View DTC migration using 40X Nomarski microscopy.
Transfer 5 young adults to new plates seeded with RNAi bacteria.
Take the day off on Day 7.
Analyze young adult progeny animals as described for Day 6 on Day 8.
If the worms aren't old enough, analyze them on Day 9.
